observed_failure.local_beacon_transport: Initial unchanged beacon CREATE received GitHub 409 branch-head mismatch (main advanced) and the identical CREATE succeeded on the immediate retry.
observed_failure.diagnosis: Legacy CAS_LOST conflation could spend a real authority slot on unrelated branch-head churn.

semantics: Explicit BRANCH_HEAD_MOVED gets one byte-identical same-path CREATE retry.
That retry performs no pre-read and consumes no authority attempt/lane collision.
A second consecutive head movement becomes CLAIM_TRANSPORT_UNSTABLE and stops.

truth_boundary: Static guard is green. Post-patch real claim traffic has not yet demonstrated BRANCH_HEAD_MOVED recovery, so EFF025 remains STATIC_GUARDED_PENDING_RUNTIME rather than RATCHETED.
